features.title: Export a thread to a portable .dshthread bundle
features.summary: A thread's row menu (Export…) and the command palette (Export this thread…) build one gzip file holding the thread's whole Session log — messages, tool calls and results, title, model — and every attachment it cites, stored once by sha256. The browser downloads it in chunks; the agent tool writes it to an absolute Host path. No Session id, working directory or credential is needed to replay it.
features.currentSurface: thread row menu: Export… (also command palette: Export this thread…)
failureModes: A thread this machine does not store is refused with a pointer to the sidebar.
An attachment the store can no longer read is left out and counted, instead of failing the export.
The agent tool refuses a relative path and an existing file, so it never overwrites one.
A staged download the browser abandons expires after 15 minutes.

verification.testName: collects each attachment once by content, keeps no host path, and describes the thread

features.title: Import a .dshthread bundle as a new thread
features.summary: Import thread… in the command palette uploads a bundle, previews its title, message, event and attachment counts and model, and refuses one this DSH cannot replay (another bundle version or Session log format, a damaged log, an attachment failing its checksum). On import the attachments are saved into this machine's store, their references rewritten, and the log stored as a new thread with a fresh id in the chosen project, an existing folder or the home folder; the thread opens. The agent tools inspect and import a bundle file on the Host.
failureModes: A file that is not a bundle, or a bundle from another format or DSH Session log format, is refused before anything is stored, with what to change.
A missing folder or an unknown project is refused with a pointer to the destination picker.
A log this DSH stores but cannot replay is archived and reported, never left as a thread that fails to open.
Sub-agent threads are not carried: the parent's tool results that summarize them are.
